errorCodes.meaning: `from` is after `to`, the range is longer than 400 days, or it begins before the community's oldest retained day. `details.earliest` states the oldest day it holds.
Grouping or filtering by member was asked for a `private` room, whose host cannot tell members apart.
`cursor` was not issued by this community for this filter, grouping and sort.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.

ScopeLimits.description: Limits at one scope. Every member is optional: an absent member means the scope sets no limit of that kind, and the next wider scope's limit, or the host's ceiling, governs. All sizes are ciphertext bytes.

maxBytes.description: The total size of the committed and reserved blobs the scope may hold.

maxFileBytes.description: The largest single blob the scope accepts. Never above 1 GiB, the transfer ceiling (BlobManifest).

maxFiles.description: The number of committed blobs the scope may hold. 0 refuses every upload at this scope.

ScopeLimits.title: ScopeLimits

StorageConfigId.description: A storage config's identifier, chosen by the administrator who creates it and immutable thereafter: lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens, at most 64 characters (`eu-s3-primary`, `walrus-main`). Unique within the community. Never reused after a config is retired, because blobs name their config by this value.
StorageConfigId.title: StorageConfigId

UsageRow.description: One group's figures. Holdings as of the read (or the end of the day, on a `day` row); activity over the range (or the day).

capacityBytes.description: On a `storageConfig` row, the config's capacity when it has one.

limits.description: On a `room` row the room's limits, on a `member` row (one room selected) that member's.

storageConfig.description: Present on a `storageConfig` row, and on a `room` row as the room's assigned config.

schema.description: A room-hosting administrator reports the storage and activity of the community's hosted rooms, grouped by room, member, storage config or day. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

filter.description: Every member optional; all given apply together.

from.description: First UTC day of the range. Default: 29 days before `to`.

member.description: One member's figures, across the `attributed` rooms selected.

roomId.description: The room's identifier, as its owner minted it.

to.description: Last UTC day of the range, inclusive. Default: today.

groupBy.description: What each row describes. `day` is the daily history of whatever the filter selects.

limit.description: Page size. The community chooses when absent (50 in the reference implementation).

schema.title: VTC Rooms — Usage — payload
